# BRIEF FOR THE APPELLANT

IN THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE NINTH CIRCUIT

## TABLE OF AUTHORITIES

Marbury v. Madison, 5 U.S. 137 (1803) .......... 4

Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc., 467 U.S. 837 (1984) .......... 7

Younger v. Harris, 401 U.S. 37 (1971) .......... 9

## ARGUMENT I — THE DISTRICT COURT ERRED

Id. at 142. The district court's reasoning cannot be reconciled with the record before it.

The standard of review is de novo. See Marbury v. Madison, 5 U.S. 137, 177 (1803). The court below misapplied that standard. Marbury, 5 U.S. at 178. The same error appears later in the order. Madison, 5 U.S. at 180.

## ARGUMENT II — NO DEFERENCE IS OWED

Id. The agency never addressed the statutory text at all.

See Skidmore v. Swift & Co., 323 U.S. 134 (1944). The agency's position is inconsistent with its own prior guidance.

## CONCLUSION

The judgment should be reversed.

# ANSWER

## RESPONSES TO THE ALLEGATIONS

Defendant denies the allegations of paragraph 1.

As to the allegations of paragraph 2, Defendant does not know whether they are true or false.

Defendant admits the allegations of paragraph 3.
